title: The Economics of Owning a Movie Theater Chain
description:
A theater keeps almost nothing from your $15 movie ticket. So how does the business actually survive?

In this video:

Why the ticket is a loss leader and the concession stand is the real business
The concept of "perishable inventory" that makes every empty seat a permanent loss
How a single underperforming blockbuster can threaten an entire chain
Why Cineworld/Regal, one of the biggest chains on earth, filed for bankruptcy
The break-even occupancy rate a theater actually needs to survive

Going to the movies was never really about the movie.
